notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.09
notes.content:
New Features:
- Survey Menu: Shows an overview of your territory in a concise fashion. Clicking on the entries takes you that System, Planet or District.
- New Option: Auto Resolve All Combats. Found in the Options menu.
- New Option: Go to Build Location when Building. This toggles whether or not building a particular Challenge or Infrastructure will cause the menu to take you that location.
- Infrastructure and Challenge hover popups now show Bureaucratic Overhead contribution.
- The number of Battles Pending is now displayed beneath the Next Turn button.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed several popups that went off the screen on some resolutions.
- Fixed an infrequent cause of save corruption.
- Fixed crashes at startup related to computers without sound cards. (Or that The Viceroy thought had no sound cards.)
- Fixed some background jumping during Advancing Turn calculations.

notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.08
notes.content:
Balance Changes:
- Changes to Tax Rates are now applied at a rate of 1% per turn, instead of all at once, in order to promote social stability throughout the Commonwealth.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an infrequent crash bug in the System-Planet-District Menu.
- Fixed an infrequent crash bug in the Fleet Menu.

notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.07
notes.content:
New Features:
- Mass Build implemented. Viceroys can now order the construction of Planet and District level projects and cures over an entire Planet or System at once.
- Enter/Return now advanced to the Next Turn while in the Territory screen.
- Technology and Challenge Icons now graphically display whether they impact a System, Planet or District with three, two or one dots. (We are still working on improving this!)

Balance Changes:
- Buildings and challenges that change Crowding Capacity now give +/- .25 Crowding Capacity, down from 1.

Bug Fixes:
- All Science Achievements are now awarded properly.
- Fixed a short lived display error in the Fleet screen.
- Fixed two rare crash bugs introduced in the last patch.
- Negative credit balances now display in red in the System-Planet-District screen.

notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.06
notes.content:
New Features:
- A new Patrol option in the Policy Menu makes Fleet 1 automatically move itself to any system where the Rebellion attacks one of your other fleets. 
- Right clicking Ships in the Fleet Menu now removes it without dragging.
- Percentage style Policy settings can now be changed rapidly by holding down the mouse button, just like in the Skills Menu.
- Citizens can now be mass assigned at the District level by clicking on an empty production area.
- Reduced both memory usage and load times.
- Added subtle color coding to Challenges and Projects according to their bonus type.

Balance Changes:
- Technologies can now be abandoned in the Technology Menu, destroying all non-Protected Projects and Challenge Cures requiring them.

Bug Fixes:
- Objectives are now Protected upon completion, as was originally intended.
- WASD/Arrow navigation in System-Planet-District Menu now retains current sub-page.
- Zooming to Systems and Portals in the Territory menu now centers properly.
- Added another Options button to the Main Menu to help people whose monitor resolution was incorrectly determined in such a fashion that the options icon in the upper left hand corner was not visible.
- Corrected the tool-tip for 'Gift of the Union.'

notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.05
notes.content:
New Features:
- You can now navigate the System-Planet-District menu with WASD and Arrow Keys to rapidly cycle through your entire Territory.
- Right clicking the planet in the System-Planet-District menu now takes your view 'up' a level, to Planet if you are at District level and System if you are at Planet level. (Left clicking still takes you 'down'.)
- Viceregal ships now come with better default equipment and faction appropriate randomized weapons.
- Right clicking a ship in the Fleet Menu now builds it without dragging and dropping it.
- Clicking on the Credits display now takes you to the Policy menu for more details.
- Improved Main Menu to make Options Menu access more clear.

Balance Changes:
- Due to the increasingly unstable political situation in the Commonwealth, Objectives now change every turn whether or not they were accomplished.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a Maximum Fleet Capacity error dealing with the Admiral Skill.
- Fixed a UI error where the Confirm button in Command in Battle would not work until you had moved or rotated a ship.

notes.title: The Viceroy - V1.01
notes.content:
New Features:
- Right clicking Projects and Challenges in the System-Planet-District Menu now builds them without drag and drop.
- Right clicking a Challenge in the Technology Challenge display now takes you to a place still threatened by that Challenge.

Balance Changes:
- Bureaucratic Overhead buildings now give -5% Bureaucratic Overhead instead of -10%, but generate no Bureaucratic Overhead themselves. (A substantial buff.)
- Upkeep Reduction buildings now generate no Upkeep themselves.

Bug Fixes:
- Improved save system stability. (The save system we use uses a variety of methods depending on your system, and some of them had not been properly taken into account.)
